rules.key: Grey Knights count as Space Marines in all respects
rules.text: Grey Knights count as Space Marines in all respects and as such follow all rules for Space Marines as written on pages 92-94.
rules.why: Viittaa jaettuihin Space Marine -saantoihin. Korteilla nakyy SPECIAL_HULL_RULES-saanto 'astartes_core', jonka fleet-kuvio kattaa myos Grey Knightsin.

rules.key: Grey Knights may not take Thunderhawk annihilators
rules.text: (Note: Grey Knights may not take Thunderhawk annihilators)
rules.why: Ordnance-valinta pelin aikana. Tarkea ero Space Marines Crusade -listaan, joka nimenomaan saa ne.

rules.key: If the fleet is above 750 points an Inquisitor Lord must lead the fleet
rules.text: If the fleet is above 750 points an Inquisitor Lord must lead the fleet.
rules.why: Kirjan sanamuoto on 'above', joka lisattiin MAND_GT-kaavaan 7.9.2026. Ennen sita tama komentajapakko jai valvomatta.

rules.key: If an Inquisitorial Cruiser is present the Inquisitor Lord must be placed aboard it
rules.text: If an Inquisitorial Cruiser is present the Inquisitor Lord must be placed aboard it. If the Inquisitorial Cruiser is not present but a Blackship is then the Inquisitor Lord must be placed aboard the Blackship. Otherwise the Inquisitor must be placed on the most expensive ship.

rules.key: may purchase up to two more re-rolls for +25 points each
rules.text: An Inquisitor Lord gets one re-roll, and may purchase up to two more re-rolls for +25 points each.
rules.why: Hinnoiteltu optio; rivit 'One extra re-roll 25' ja 'Two extra re-rolls 50' ovat valittavissa.

rules.key: You may include a single Grey Knights Battle barge if the remainder of the fleet is at least worth 1000 points
rules.text: You may include a single Grey Knights Battle barge if the remainder of the fleet is at least worth 1000 points. Furthermore an Ordo Malleus Inquisitor Lord must lead in the fleet.
rules.why: Valvottu 9.9.2026 (kohta 8): kirjasta luettu saanto lisatty build_data.py:n RULE_PICKS-tauluun; resolveFleet tarkistaa sen. allowed_at basis=remainder: laivaston muiden alusten pisteet >= 1000 JA Ordo Malleus Inquisitor Lord laivastossa (cond_pick). Komentajan sijoitus lippulaivaksi jaa pelaajalle. Aiempi puute: Kaksi ehtoa: pisteraja ja tietty komentaja. Kumpaakaan ei voi valvoa - pisterajaan sidottua lupaa ei ole saantotyyppina, eika komentajan lajia voi sitoa rivin k

rules.key: A Grey Knights fleet may include a single Inquisitorial Cruiser
rules.text: A Grey Knights fleet may include a single Inquisitorial Cruiser in the fleet.
rules.why: Maara yksi valvottu rivirajana mx=1 kirjan merkinnasta '(0-1)'.

rules.key: A Grey Knights fleet may include a single Blackship
rules.text: A Grey Knights fleet may include a single Blackship, which as a special vessel does not count toward or against other ship limits in the fleet.

rules.key: One Grey Knights Strike Cruiser may be taken per 500 points
rules.text: One Grey Knights Strike Cruiser may be taken per 500 points (e.g. one from 0-500 points, two from 501-1000 points, etc.).
rules.why: Valvottu 9.9.2026 (kohta 8): kirjasta luettu saanto lisatty build_data.py:n RULE_PICKS-tauluun; resolveFleet tarkistaa sen. Aiempi puute: Pisterajaan sidottu maara yhdelle listariville, ei osiolle.

rules.key: escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2
rules.text: You may include any number of escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2-6 unless specified (see pg. 13)

rules.key: The vessel embarking the Inquisitor Lord or one Grey Knights vessel may take Grey Knight Terminators
rules.text: Grey Knights Terminators +50 pts. The vessel embarking the Inquisitor Lord or one Grey Knights vessel may take Grey Knight Terminators.
rules.why: Hinnoiteltu optio; rivi 'Grey Knights Terminators 50 pts' on valittavissa.

rules.key: Any Grey Knights capital ship in the fleet may embark an Honour Guard
rules.text: Grey Knights Honour Guard +10 pts. Any Grey Knights capital ship in the fleet may embark an Honour Guard for +10 points.
rules.why: Hinnoiteltu optio; rivi 'Grey Knights Honour Guard 10 pts' on valittavissa.

rules.key: Every Grey Knights capital ship in the fleet mounts hexagrammic wards
rules.text: Every Grey Knights capital ship in the fleet mounts hexagrammic wards throughout its hull and ignores any Chaos marks or Daemonship effects affecting leadership or boarding actions.
rules.why: Pelinaikainen vaikutus; koskee kaikkia listan runkoaluksia automaattisesti.

rules.key: An enemy Chaos fleet may add one Mark of Chaos; or upgrade a cruiser to a Daemonship
rules.text: A Grey Knights fleet will only be called when intense demonic activity threatens to overrun an entire Sector. An enemy Chaos fleet may add one Mark of Chaos; or upgrade a cruiser to a Daemonship; for no aditional cost, for each of the following included in the Grey Knights Fleet: ... Ordo Malleus Inquisitor Lord ... Grey Knights Strike Cruiser
rules.why: Vastustajan saama etu, ei oman laivaston koostumusta.

rules.key: A Grey Knights fleet led by an Inquisitor Lord has an attack rating of 3
rules.text: A Grey Knights fleet led by an Inquisitor Lord has an attack rating of 3 unless a Blackship is accompanying the fleet, in which case its attack rating is 2.

rules.key: will not take ships from or provide ships to any other fleet list
rules.text: A Grey Knights fleet will not take ships from or provide ships to any other fleet list as reserves or allies, including Imperial Navy, Rogue Trader or Adeptus Mechanicus fleet lists.
rules.why: 1.1 (14.9.2026): sama kielto kuin Crusadella (res_ban). Grey Knights ei ole s.14:n rotuluettelossa, joten rotuportti estaisi jo suurimman osan, mutta kielto antaa oikean syyn ja kattaa myos antamisen.

extra_entries.name: Grey Knights Strike Cruiser
extra_entries.why: Kirjan hinta sivulla 145 on painovirhe ('vvv'). Sama alus maksaa 165 pts sivulla 138. Lisatty kasin ENTRY_ADDS-taulussa, joka vaatii lahdelauseen loytyvan osion tekstista.

notes: Tama lista erotettiin Inkvisitiosta 7.9.2026. Kirjassa sivulla 144 on oma otsikko 'GREY KNIGHTS FLEET LIST' ja sen alla omat FLEET COMMANDER-, CAPITAL SHIPS-, ESCORTS- ja ATTACK RATING -osiot. Ennen erottamista ne nakyivat Inkvisition alla kaksoiskappaleina.

Erottaminen paljasti kolme piilossa ollutta sidonnaisuutta, jotka kaikki oli sidottu listan NIMEEN: kaksi upgrades.py:n injektiota, kaksi build_data.py:n FIXES-korjausta ja yksi test_validator.js:n testi. Kaikki korjattiin osoittamaan Grey Knightsiin.

Kirja kirjoittaa sivulla 145 saattajien sivuviitteet vaarin: 'Rapid strike vessel (Sword) (pg. 104) (pg. 80)' - sivu 80 on Falchion ja sivu 82 on Sword. FIXES korjaa nama sivuille 82 ja 84. Sama virhe koskee myos rulesivua: kirja sanoo 104, oikea on 106.
Grey Knights Strike Cruiserin hinta on kirjassa lukukelvoton ('vvv'). Se on lisatty kasin sivun 138 hinnalla 165 pts.
